GLGE We use the GLGE (General Language Generation Evaluation Benchmark) to evaluate the ability of BART-JANUS on sequence generation tasks. We selected three different tasks: Abstractive Text Summarization dataset Xsum (227K article and summary pairs), Answer-aware Question Generation dataset SQuAD 1.1 (98K answer, passage, and question data triples), and Conversational Question Answering dataset PersonaChat (150k persona profile, conversation history, and response data triples).

We use the GLGE benchmark to evaluate BART‑JANUS on sequence generation tasks, selecting XSum (abstractive text summarization), SQuAD 1.1 (answer‑aware question generation), and PersonaChat (conversational question answering).

We validate our approach on multiple sequence generation tasks. For neural machine translation, we train our model from scratch. For other tasks, we first perform pre-training using our methods on BART-base to obtain BART-JANUS, then use the downstream task to finetune the BART-JANUS.

quote: report test set performance by measuring BLEU
We report test set performance by measuring BLEU. For XSum we present results with ROUGE‑1, ROUGE‑2, ROUGE‑L, METEOR. For PersonaChat we also report Distinct‑1 and Distinct‑2 scores.
